Corrigible means willing to revise one's own interpretation in response to the interlocutor's reply.

Actually frequentemente introduz uma cor: Actually often introduces a correction or something that contrasts with an expectation. For “currently,” currently or at the moment usually work. A correction with actually can sound firm: context and tone matter.
Actually não costuma significar atualmen: Actually usually does not mean currently. Compare: Actually, the meeting is tomorrow. Here I am correcting information. I’m currently working from home. Here I talk about the current situation. Which would you use to say what you study today?
Actually não significa atualmente. Para: Actually does not mean currently. For the current situation, use currently; actually usually corrects or clarifies something.
Actually significa 'na verdade', não 'at: Actually means 'in fact,' not 'currently.' In assessments, it can correct an expectation.
Adaptar argumentos complexos, preservar: Adapt complex arguments, preserve voices, and respond to objections with precision and flexibility.
Adaptar não significa trocar uma conclus: Adapt does not mean replacing a probabilistic conclusion with certainty. Uncertainty can also be communicated in familiar language.
Adaptar não é licença para inventar qual: Adapt is not a license to invent any joke. Preserve the discursive function and declare losses when reference, sound, and meaning cannot coexist.
Adapte a crítica para leitores brasileir: Adapt the critique for Brazilian readers in 150–190 words. Preserve facts, authorship, and evaluative strength without confusing literal translation or expanded accusation. Add a short note explaining a reference kept, paraphrased, or omitted.
Address a concern não significa provar q: Address a concern does not mean proving it false. The expression indicates that you face the issue and offer a response.

Adicionar however a toda frase não cria: Adding however to every sentence does not create cohesion. Use contrast only when ideas really contrast.
Adjetivos curtos geralmente recebem -er: Short adjectives usually take -er in the comparative: cheaper. Longer adjectives often use more: more comfortable. Than introduces the second term of the comparison. Better and worse are irregular forms of good and bad.
Adjetivos geralmente vêm antes do substa: Adjectives usually come before the noun: a small room. They can also come after be: The room is small. They do not take plural or gender inflection: two small rooms. Very intensifies a characteristic.
Adjetivos não variam em número. Rooms re: Adjectives do not vary in number. Rooms takes -s; small remains the same.
Admitted sugere reconhecer algo frequent: Admitted suggests acknowledging something often unfavorable. Said or stated may be more accurate when the source is simply presenting their position.
Advice é não contável: use some advice o: Advice is uncountable: use some advice or a piece of advice, not an advice. Should to check adds to unnecessarily.

After that é 'depois disso' e mantém a s: After that means 'after that' and maintains the sequence breakfast → departure.

Alguns verbos não formam o passado com -: Some verbs do not form the past with -ed: eat → ate, buy → bought, see → saw, take → took. Learn the form along with a context. In the affirmative, all subjects use the same past: I bought, she bought.
Alguns verbos pedem -ing depois, como en: Some verbs require -ing after them, like enjoy and avoid. Others usually require to + verb, like decide and hope. Learn the pair: enjoy reading, decide to leave. The meaning of some verbs changes according to the pattern; do not apply a single rule to all.

Although introduz o contraste entre disp: Although introduces the contrast between availability and adequacy not yet confirmed.
Although introduz sales increased, uma o: Although introduces sales increased, a clause with subject and verb. The other options require a different construction.
Although introduz uma oração de contrast: Although introduces a contrast clause: Although it was late, we stayed. But links contrasting ideas differently. In a simple construction, it is not necessary to use although and but together to mark the same contrast.
Always significa sempre e, com is, vem d: Always means always and, with is, comes after the verb.

An article argued that public workshops: An article argued that public workshops always attract more participants when they are free. A neighborhood project challenged the claim: attendance fell after fees were removed because the organizer also changed the venue to a less accessible building. The case did not establish that charging fees increased attendance. It showed that price was not the only relevant factor and that the article's universal wording was too strong. A revised claim linked participation to affordability, location, scheduling and the needs of the intended audience.
An essay declares that institutions shou: An essay declares that institutions should listen to every complaint, then warns against allowing the loudest voices to set every priority. One reader sees a contradiction: how can an institution listen without acting? Another distinguishes acknowledgement from automatic compliance. The essay's closing paragraph supports that distinction by calling for published reasons when a request is declined, rather than promising that all requests will be granted. It leaves unresolved how competing needs should be weighted. A careful response can defend the coherence of the listening principle while criticizing the absence of a sufficiently explicit decision procedure.
An essay on urban redevelopment is title: An essay on urban redevelopment is titled 'A Room of One's Own, at Market Rate'. Readers familiar with the earlier phrase hear a claim about space, independence and exclusion before the argument begins. The added commercial qualifier changes aspiration into a question about affordability. The essay never names its source, so the critic cannot prove that every reader will recognize it or that the author intended every association attached to the original. Still, the altered phrase clearly frames private space as both an ideal and a commodity, a tension developed throughout the essay.

Ao avaliar uma fonte, separe autoridade,: When evaluating a source, separate authority, method, and relevance. Peer-reviewed describes an editorial process but doesn't guarantee every conclusion is definitive. Ask who produced the data, how the sample was formed, what limitations were declared, and if the evidence really answers the question under debate.
Ao comentar dados, increased after descr: When commenting on data, increased after describes temporal sequence; caused states causality. May have contributed presents a hypothesis cautiously. Compare groups, consider alternative explanations, and adjust certainty to study design instead of using strong words to fill an evidence gap.
Ao comparar os exemplos, o que precisa m: When comparing examples, what needs to change for the sentence to express the desired idea?
Ao comparar textos, confira se tratam do: When comparing texts, check if they address the same time, version, or context. A more recent notice may update another. Cite the source of each piece of information and indicate differences without assuming any contradiction is an error. Date and scope help decide what counts.
Ao confirmar o nome, enviamos o nome val: When confirming the name, we send the validated name in a short greeting to Google Gemini to synthesize Sparky's Achird voice. This happens before the age question. Under 13s later need guardian confirmation to complete; refusal removes personalization and provisional audio from Sparky's storage. This simple confirmation does not documentally verify guardian identity.
Ao confirmar, enviamos seu nome ao Googl: When confirming, we send your name to Google to generate Sparky's private greeting. Do not include surname if you prefer not to.
Ao discutir acesso a cursos comunitários: When discussing access to community courses, we count vacancies. It's understandable: full classes exclude people. But a vacancy is just the start. Imagine a course with free spots at six, while the last bus from a distant neighborhood arrives at six twenty. Technically open, in practice forcing some to miss the initial explanation or give up. First point: capacity and real possibility of use are different issues. Second: enrollment shows who entered, not who considered entering and gave up. Using only participant opinions may improve service mainly for those already able to access it. This doesn't make their opinions irrelevant; it requires asking what experiences are missing before taking the sample as the whole community.
Ao entrar em um ônibus ou trem, use Does: When boarding a bus or train, use Does this bus go to…? to confirm the destination before paying or sitting. To indicate where to get off, use get off at + stop: get off at Market Street. Change can mean changing lines. Asking Is it the next stop? helps confirm the sequence without assuming the first stop is correct.
Ao entrar, recebemos do Google seu nome,: When entering, we receive from Google your name, verified email, and account identifier. This data identifies you and allows checking if your email is authorized. The integration uses only basic identification; it does not request access to Gmail, Drive, or contacts.
Ao fechar uma negociação complexa, difer: When closing a complex negotiation, differentiate commitments, dependencies, and review mechanisms. Subject to indicates conditioning; pending keeps the issue awaiting decision. A final record must allow someone absent to execute the agreement without inferring implicit obligations. Ao relatar uma notícia, atribua a fonte: When reporting news, attribute the source and delimit the scope. Is reported / was measured highlights the result or process without omitting where the information comes from. An average of some locations does not necessarily describe each person or the whole system. Preserve in the summary the conditions that change the headline's interpretation.
Ao relatar uma reunião, diferencie o que: When reporting a meeting, differentiate what was decided, suggested, and postponed. Agreed to indicates commitment; suggested is a proposal and can take a verb in -ing. Indirect speech often shifts verb tense, but concrete dates are safer than tomorrow when the reader will see the text on another day.
Ao resolver uma tensão doméstica, descre: When resolving a domestic tension, describe specific behaviors before interpreting intentions. I thought we were… makes a past assumption visible. What if we + simple past can propose a present alternative; it doesn't necessarily indicate a past event. Reformulate the problem as negotiable and establish a review of the agreement.

Coordenação eficaz transforma pedidos va: Effective coordination turns vague requests into tasks, responsibilities, and deadlines. Rather than compares a chosen option with another avoided. Could I have…? é uma forma educada de pe: "Could I have…?" is a polite way to ask for something at a café or counter. Add "without + item" to remove an ingredient: without onions. Could descreve habilidade geral no passa: "Could" describes general ability in the past: I could swim at six. "Was/were able to" can highlight the success of a specific action. Could formula um pedido mitigado de disp: "Could" forms a mitigated request for availability; other forms do not produce the proposed construction.
Could you + verbo é uma maneira educada: "Could you + verb" is a polite way to make a request. To check what you understood, use "Do you mean…?" This allows the conversation to continue without guessing.
Could you explain what does a visitor do: "Could you explain what does a visitor do?" mixes orders. After "explain," use "what a visitor does."
Could you tell me where is the office? m: "Could you tell me where is the office?" keeps the inversion in the wrong part. The inversion is already in "Could you."
Could you tell me…? torna uma pergunta m: "Could you tell me…?" makes a question more indirect. After this opening, use the affirmative order: "where the office is," not "where is the office." For yes/no questions, introduce "if" or "whether": Do you know if it's open?
Credibilidade institucional não elimina: Institutional credibility does not eliminate methodological limits. Avoid rejecting an entire source for one limitation or treating it as final proof because of prestige.

Crie uma pequena história com bought, at: Create a short story with bought, ate, and saw. Keep the actions in a defined past period.
Crie uma versão pessoal de “{0}”. Diga-a: Create a personal version of “{0}”. Say it once carefully and once copying the natural rhythm of the audio.

Custos de três anos e demonstração de ac: Three-year costs and demonstration of accessibility allow comparison of relevant criteria; initial price alone does not resolve the decision.

Dear não significa necessariamente intim: "Dear" does not necessarily mean intimacy: it is a conventional opening of a formal email. Avoid abbreviated slang when the recipient does not know it.

Decidi sem fingir certeza absoluta?: Did I decide without pretending absolute certainty?

Defenda por três minutos a crítica da au: Defend for three minutes the author's critique in front of someone who interprets any praise as approval.
Defenda sua leitura por quatro minutos e: Defend your reading for four minutes and then argue, for one minute, the best objection to it.

Depois de although, use uma oração com s: After although, use a clause with subject and verb. Despite usually requires a noun or -ing; do not swap them without adjusting the structure.

Depois de doesn't, use o infinitivo sem: After doesn't, use the infinitive without to: drink.
Depois de enviar uma resposta, ela não p: After sending a response, it cannot be changed.
Depois de how to usamos o infinitivo: ho: After how to we use the infinitive: how to get. The second to, in get to the library, introduces the destination; it is not part of a verb inversion.
Depois de how to usamos o verbo base get: After how to we use the base verb get. Getting would require another structure, and got puts the question in the past without reason.
Depois de perder um trem, Great, another: After missing a train, Great, another delay can be ironic. The interpretation combines situation, words, and intonation. There is no single tone that marks all irony; cultural differences can make the intention less evident.
Depois de quarenta minutos esperando apr: After forty minutes waiting for supposedly instant approval, a reviewer wrote a compliment about efficiency. Depois de shouldn't, use a forma base sh: After shouldn't, use the base form share, without -s and without to. The recommendation is not to share.
Depois de this, a frase pede o substanti: After this, the sentence requires the noun distinction. Distinct is an adjective and distinctly is an adverb.
Depois de would usamos a forma base work: After would we use the base form work. Works would be third person present, and working would require another auxiliary or a different construction.
Depois de would you mind, use closing, n: After would you mind, use closing, not to close. The answer Yes may seem like the person cares; Not at all makes acceptance clearer.
Depois do pedido de Ana, a recepcionista: After Ana's request, the receptionist repeats B, four, seven, nine. The order of the two middle numbers was not reversed.

Desconhecer uma sigla local não indica b: Not knowing a local acronym does not indicate low intellectual or linguistic ability. Explain the reference before reducing the complexity of the idea.

Descreva três ações em uma foto imaginár: Describe three actions in an imaginary photo using is/are + -ing. Include a plural subject.
Descreva um apartamento em três frases:: Describe an apartment in three sentences: number of rooms, one piece of furniture, and one kitchen feature.

Descreva uma atividade em andamento com: Describe an ongoing activity with duration and another with a quantified result. Compare the verb forms.
Descreva uma família real ou fictícia co: Describe a real or fictional family with have and has. Personal data is not necessary.
Descreva uma festa usando many, much e a: Describe a party using many, much, and a lot of. Use at least one negative.
Descreva uma geladeira fictícia: duas co: Describe a fictional refrigerator: two things that are there with some and one that is not there with any.
Descreva uma pessoa e um objeto sem dize: Describe a person and an object without saying their names, using who and which/that to identify them.
Descrever a melhora como apenas adequada: Describing the improvement as merely adequate introduces a judgment beyond the numbers.
Descrevi a objeção sem distorcê-la?: Did I describe the objection without distorting it?
Descrevi fatos sem exagerar?: Did I describe facts without exaggerating?
Desculpe avisar tão perto, mas a sala de: Sorry to inform so close, but the Thursday room will be used for emergency maintenance. The center offered Friday morning. Before accepting, I wanted to check if you could still conduct the workshop.
Desculpe. Referia-me aos títulos inconsi: Sorry. I was referring to inconsistent titles and missing sources, but I see I did not explain that. The sentence was much broader than the problem. I should not have expected you to reconstruct specific feedback that was only in my head.
Despite recebe substantivo ou forma em -: Despite takes a noun or -ing form; although takes a clause. Do not write despite the trial was short.

Destacar uma palavra ajuda a indicar o c: Highlighting a word helps indicate the intended contrast. In I ordered the BLUE folder, the contrast can be with another color; highlighting I, it can be with another person. These are possible readings, not automatic translations.
Destaque substantivos, verbos e contrast: Highlight nouns, verbs, and contrasts. Reduce grammatical words; the schwa is short and relaxed, without a full Portuguese vowel.

Did já marca o passado; a forma escrita: Did already marks the past; the standard written form is Did you use to…?
Did you were there? mixes auxiliaries. With be, the question is Were you there?
Didn't nega a primeira opção; took a bus: Didn't deny the first option; took a bus instead presents the alternative used.
Didn't went está incorreto; use didn't g: Didn't went is incorrect; use didn't go. Wasn't is for be, it does not replace didn't with travel.
Diferenciei intenção provável e certeza?: Did I differentiate probable intention and certainty?

Diga como você vai a dois lugares. Use b: Say how you go to two places. Use by with one transport and on foot for the other.
Diga sua resposta em voz alta e depois r: Say your answer out loud and then rephrase without reading. This extra practice does not assign a grade, coins, or completion in the main course.
Diga sua versão em voz alta. Depois, ouç: Say your version out loud. Then, listen to the model and repeat, noting the most emphasized words and how they link in speech.
Diria ser razoável frustrar-se com a ava: It would be reasonable to be frustrated with the promised and incomplete evaluation and explain the responsibility for correcting the gap. Disagree with é a combinação usada para: Disagree with is the combination used to disagree with a statement; to and for do not complete this pattern.

Disse o que os dados sustentam e o que n: Did you say what the data supports and what it does not support?
Distingui conteúdo factual e atitude?: Did I distinguish factual content and attitude?
Distingui entrega parcial e final?: Did I distinguish partial and final delivery?
Distingui fonte e voz do narrador?: Did I distinguish source and narrator's voice?
Distingui interpretação plausível e inte: Did I distinguish plausible interpretation and proven intention?
Distingui mérito local e endosso global?: Did I distinguish local merit and global endorsement?
Distingui não implicado de refutado?: Did I distinguish not implied from refuted?

Distingui teste temporário de serviço pe: Did I distinguish temporary test from permanent service?

Distinguish between A and B apresenta a: Distinguish between A and B presents the difference between the two named elements.

Do you are listening? mistura dois model: Do you are listening? mixes two models. For present continuous, use Are you listening? Also note the to in listen to.

Dobrou pode soar enorme quando a base é: Doubling can sound huge when the base is small. Just four can also minimize a serious risk. Offer both scales and the decision context.

Doing combina com are para they. Do não: Doing combines with are for they. Do does not replace be in the continuous.

Dominar uma expressão idiomática inclui: Mastering an idiomatic expression includes its evaluative value and its local scope. Escreva uma pequena história em que algu: Write a short story in which someone arrives late because an action had already happened. Use past perfect once.

Escreva uma pergunta de preço, uma de qu: Write a price question, a countable quantity question, and an uncountable quantity question.

Escreva uma previsão de duas frases para: Write a two-sentence forecast for a fictional city and indicate suitable clothing.
Escreva uma reclamação de quatro frases: Write a four-sentence complaint about a fictional order: fact, problem, effect, and desired solution.

Facilite uma troca de três minutos em qu: Facilitate a three-minute exchange in which someone firmly contests a proposal. Reformulate without softening the position, confirm fidelity, and respond to You're making this too complicated, defending clarity of access without promising to eliminate differences.
Falei com o atendente. O ônibus sai da e: I spoke to the attendant. The bus leaves from the south entrance at five fifteen. It should arrive at the coast around seven thirty, depending on traffic. Our tickets are valid and we don't need to book again.
Falta um dos dois cadernos. O pedido é e: One of the two notebooks is missing. The request is to send this item, not to duplicate the entire purchase.
Fato, opinião e grau de certeza: Fact, opinion, and degree of certainty
Fazer um pedido com uma alteração: Make a request with a change
Faça a primeira pergunta e imagine uma r: Ask the first question and imagine a short answer. Orally formulate two follow-up questions that depend on that answer, without abruptly changing the subject.
Faça duas perguntas sobre hábitos, uma c: Ask two questions about habits, one with Do you and another with Does your friend. Write short answers.
Faça em português um registro de 150–190: Write in Portuguese a record of 150–190 words for residents: separate contested claim, admitted failure, and requirements for new expenditure. Do not invent a budget or date that was not informed. Preserve legitimate concern without repeating the accusation as fact.
Faça em português uma nota editorial de: Write in Portuguese an editorial note of 90–120 words for the newspaper board, explaining the focus, the source gap, and the details that need checking.
Faça em português uma passagem de negoci: Write in Portuguese a negotiation passage of 150–190 words for another organizer. Separate options, unconfirmed costs, responsibilities, deadlines, and essential conditions. Explain why the event cannot yet be announced and when the provisional reservation should be released.
Faça o pedido em uma conversa informal e: Make the request in an informal conversation and then in an external meeting, explaining how the tone changed.
Faça um convite oral de 90 segundos. Res: Make a 90-second oral invitation. Respond to the person who says: I can help, but only for an hour. Propose a compatible task and confirm understanding.
Faça uma apresentação de dois minutos ex: Make a two-minute presentation explaining why the initially cheapest option may not be the best decision.
Faça uma defesa de cinco minutos, respon: Make a five-minute defense, answer three unprepared questions, and finish with a 45-second summary. Ask for feedback on accuracy, coherence, flexibility, and fluency.
Faça uma linha do tempo com dois acontec: Make a timeline with two events.
Faça uma lista com dois alimentos contáv: Make a list with two countable foods and two portions of uncountable foods.
Faça uma pergunta com Have you ever e re: Ask a question with Have you ever and answer using never. Then add a different experience you have had.
Faça uma recomendação em português de 70: Make a recommendation in Portuguese of 70–100 words to a student who needs to be available for family. Adapt the central idea without recommending total disconnection.
Fechamento do prédio às 21h30 não signif: Closing the building at 9:30 PM does not mean public programming until 9:30 PM. The cleaning and checking window is an explicit operational condition.
Feche a palavra antes de começar a próxi: Close the word before starting the next one. Avoid adding an 'i' after the final consonant.
Feche o modelo, mude o nome e troque os: Close the model, change the name, and switch roles: now you answer first and ask later.
Feel está no presente, combinando com go: Feel is in the present tense, matching go in a habitual relationship.
Ficou claro o que pedi?: Is it clear what I asked?
Fidelidade exige limites do consenso, at: Loyalty requires limits of consensus, assigning concerns and actions responsibly.
Fifteen pounds é o preço informado por u: Fifteen pounds is the price per unit; thirty would be the total for two.
Figures é plural; a passiva no passado u: Figures is plural; the past passive uses were supplied.
Final de passado sem sílaba extra: Past tense ending without extra syllable
Finalize com um critério de decisão veri: End with a verifiable decision criterion, without inventing results. Then explain the recommendation to a retailer concerned about deliveries.
Finally é 'por fim', não 'finalmente' em: Finally means 'at last,' not 'finally' in any context of relief. To organize steps, make the order explicit, not just the times.
First, then, after that e finally guiam: First, then, after that, and finally guide the order of a narrative. Use simple past for completed actions in sequence. After can come before a noun: after lunch. After that works alone as a connector: after that.
Fixei prazo e escopo?: Did I set deadline and scope?
Fiz um pedido executável?: Did I make an executable request?
Flexible, well-structured communication: Flexible, well-structured communication on complex topics; recognize implications, qualify claims, and adapt register. Sustain a position while incorporating another perspective with precise supporting detail.
Foi conjunto. Requisitos de acessibilida: It was joint. Accessibility requirements changed the delivery, and local coordinators helped with the schedule. The agreement covers two test sessions and joint review before scaling up. There is no commitment to fund the entire program. That defines the agreement, not minor caveats.
For example introduz um exemplo; such as: For example introduces an example; such as presents items in a category. An example illustrates a statement but does not alone prove a generalization. Make the link between the idea and the case clear.
For example é a expressão que introduz u: For example is the expression that introduces an illustration.
For five years se refere à Lia. Since Ma: For five years refers to Lia. Since March refers to Ana.
For indica a duração planejada da estadi: For indicates the planned duration of the stay: for three nights. Since would indicate the start.
For our neighbourhood newsletter, I'd li: For our neighborhood newsletter, I'd like to ask about the repair café. People have seen the posters, but they may not know what happens inside. Could you walk me through what a first-time visitor would actually do?
For the trial, the caretaker will mainta: For the trial, the caretaker will maintain the calendar, and organizers must record the event's end time. The residents' group will collect feedback through paper forms as well as an online survey. That matters because two attendees said they don't use the building's messaging app.
Foram relatadas esperas menores em três: Shorter waits were reported at three central points.
Foram sessenta iniciantes antes e oitent: There were sixty beginners before and eighty now. The rates are eighty and seventy-five percent. The rate dropped five percentage points, although the number of completions rose. Calling it a twenty-five percent improvement without indicating the measure would be misleading.
Foregrounds significa tornar saliente. A: Foregrounds means to make salient. The metaphor emphasizes linearity, without disproving or interrupting the trajectory.
Forme o passado e confira se a frase man: Form the past tense and check if the sentence keeps subject and complement.
Frase reconhecida. A variação de escrita: Recognized sentence. The spelling variation of the name was accepted.
Friendly descreve pessoas simpáticas; ex: Friendly describes nice people; expensive deals with price and closed with closing.
From China indica a origem; live in Reci: From China indicates origin; live in Recife indicates where she currently lives.
From indica origem. A cidade e o país po: From indicates origin. The city and country can appear in the same introduction; it's not necessary to translate 'sou' with a verb other than be.
Funciona. Deixe claro também quem fornec: It works. Also make clear who provided the numbers. We can update later with broader data. A promising initial result doesn't need to become a statement about the experience of all passengers.
Futuro, convites, compromissos e consequ: Future, invitations, commitments, and possible consequences.
Go beyond expressa ultrapassar o alcance: Go beyond expresses surpassing the scope of the available evidence.
Go straight não significa virar. Para um: Go straight does not mean turn. For a reference point, at the bank indicates where to make the turn.
Go to mostra destino; get off indica ond: Go to shows destination; get off indicates where to exit. Saying go off to get off mixes two different actions in a transport situation.
Good at writing identifica o ponto forte: Good at writing identifies the strong point; speaking in a group is still a new experience.
Good. More people finishing is a real ac: Good. More people finishing is a real achievement, and the lower rate is a real question to investigate. Holding both facts together gives the team a better starting point. A responsible briefing can recognize progress while still making a problem visible enough for someone to act on it.
Gostaria de reservar um quarto por duas: I would like to book a room for two nights.
Gosto da ideia, desde que não prometamos: I like the idea, as long as we don't promise to fix everything. Let's ask for a description of the problem in the booking, estimate the wait, and clarify that certain items may require professional service.
Gosto de atividades ao ar livre, como tr: I like outdoor activities, such as hiking.
Grave mentalmente um esclarecimento de d: Mentally record a two-minute radio clarification, with the fact first and a calm response to a suspicious question.
Grave mentalmente uma abertura de um min: Mentally record a one-minute opening for your episode. Then answer: Would this advice work for someone on call? Adjust the recommendation to that person's responsibilities.
Great nem sempre é elogio — mas não adiv: Great is not always a compliment — but don't guess
Guarde exemplos durante as lições. Tente: Save examples during lessons. Try to remember the meaning before revealing the translation.
Guardei a versão anterior, então podemos: I saved the previous version, so we can recover it. Part of the new introduction may be useful, but I don't want to keep it just to justify my time. Can we compare the two with the presentation goal, instead of who wrote each part?
Guide: You can't take photos here. You don't have to leave your bag outside; you can carry it.
H é ar, não R brasileiro: H is ar, not Brazilian R
Habilidades, pedidos, ações em andamento: Skills, requests, ongoing actions, and short messages.
Had + particípio forma o past perfect. E: Had + past participle forms the past perfect. It helps show that an action had already happened before another past moment: When I arrived, they had left. It's not necessary to use it in every sentence of a story; use it when the anteriority needs to be clear.
Had checked é o past perfect usado na co: Had checked is the past perfect used in the unreal past condition. Would belongs to the result clause.
Had started mostra que o início veio ant: Had started shows that the start came before found our seats.
Had went está incorreto: go tem particíp: Had went is incorrect: go has the past participle gone. Had combines with the past participle, not with any past form.
Has been pede a forma -ing para esse asp: Has been requires the -ing form for this continuous aspect.
Have been to normalmente expressa visita: Have been to usually expresses a visit with return or experience of knowing a place. Have gone to indicates that the person went and has not yet returned in the current context. The choice informs whether they are available here now.
Have expressa posse ou relações: I have: Have expresses possession or relationships: I have a sister. With he, she, and it, use has. My, your, his, and her come before the noun to indicate relationship or possession. In English, cousin can be male or female cousin.
Have to expressa necessidade ou obrigaçã: Have to expresses necessity or obligation: I have to leave. With he/she, use has to. In questions, use do/does: Does she have to work? In the question with does, have returns to the base form.
Have tried usa o particípio. Restarting: Have tried uses the past participle. Restarting describes the attempt made.
Have visited não equivale sempre a 'tenh: Have visited does not always mean 'I have been visiting.' In this use, 'já visitei' translates the experience accumulated so far.
Have/has + particípio forma o present pe: Have/has + past participle forms the present perfect. It can report an experience without saying when: I have visited Rome. The past participle can be regular, visited, or irregular, seen. With a finished past period like yesterday, prefer the simple past.
Have/has been + -ing pode destacar a dur: Have/has been + -ing can highlight the duration of an activity started before and still ongoing, or with recent signs. Compare I've read three pages, result, with I've been reading for an hour, duration. Stative verbs like know usually stay in the simple perfect.
Haven't finished yet explicita que a ati: Haven't finished yet makes explicit that the activity is not finished, although it has been happening for some time.
Haven't received a reply yet indica a aç: Haven't received a reply yet indicates the pending action. The sending has already happened.
He can to swim e he cans swim estão inco: He can to swim and he cans swim are incorrect. The standard is can swim for all subjects.
He retoma a brother. Não há uma irmã men: He resumes a brother. There is no sister mentioned in the dialogue.
He studies English identifica a matéria;: He studies English identifies the subject; watches a film is another activity.
He visiteds não existe: -ed já indica pa: Visiteds does not exist: -ed already indicates past tense and does not take a third-person -s. Listen to visited in the example: after the /t/ sound, -ed adds the syllable /ɪd/. Compare with worked, which ends in /t/, and cleaned, which ends in /d/.
He's gone explica a ausência de Leo. Ben: He's gone explains Leo's absence. Ben uses been for the visit he already made.
He's talking to Lia informa a pessoa com: He's talking to Lia informs the person Leo is currently speaking with.
Hedging expressa limites de conhecimento: Hedging expresses knowledge limits precisely: appears to, is likely to, and cannot rule out indicate different positions. Stacking maybe, possibly, and apparently can make the argument vague. Choose a marker proportional to the evidence and say what remains uncertain; caution is more useful when it points to the reason for the limitation.
Here's the objection you're likely to fa: Here's the objection you're likely to face: if the evidence isn't comparable, why recommend any extension at all? A skeptical committee member might say that you're using uncertainty to postpone an unpopular closure. You'll need to explain what the trial would resolve and what result could change your recommendation.
Highly precise, nuanced communication ac: Highly precise, nuanced communication across complex contexts; reformulate subtle distinctions, synthesize competing sources and manage ambiguity. Flexibility and communicative effect matter more than rare vocabulary or imitating a native accent.
Today it is cold and windy.
Hoje falamos de um pequeno experimento c: Today we talk about a small experiment with notifications. I disabled the non-essential ones for a week because I was looking at my phone during study. I expected to feel disconnected from people, but that wasn't quite what happened.
Horários exatos usam at: at four. On aco: Exact times use at: at four. On accompanies days; in usually accompanies months or parts of the day.
Houve correção antes da distribuição e u: There was a correction before distribution and a delay; the text explicitly does not report an emergency caused by the failure.
How about Saturday propõe a alternativa: How about Saturday proposes the alternative and Saturday works confirms it.
How do you spell…? pede a sequência de l: How do you spell…? asks for the sequence of letters of a word. In a registration form, first name is the given name and last name is the family name. Use That's right to confirm and No, it's… to correct information directly.
How many money está incorreto: money é n: How many money is incorrect: money is uncountable. For price, use How much.
How much pergunta o preço ou a quantidad: How much asks for the price or the quantity of something uncountable. How many asks how many countable items there are. Compare How much is this shirt? and How many shirts do you need? The choice changes the information requested.
Humor e ironia dependem de conhecimento: Humor and irony depend on shared knowledge, relationship, and channel. Might hear an accusation presents a possible reading, not a universal reaction. Adapting the register requires preserving the requested action and reconsidering assumptions. A competent paraphrase explains the joke's function without requiring the translation to provoke the same humorous effect.
Humor, registro e uma audiência que mudo: Humor, register, and an audience that has changed
Há a discordância. Alguns facilitadores: There is disagreement. Some facilitators fill pauses with their interpretation, as if speed proved participation. I want time for reflection and written contribution, available to all, not assigned to those we assume less confident.
Há ainda referência ao relógio antigo da: There is still a reference to the old town hall clock, locally associated with late notices. Without context, the joke seems like a complaint about a defective machine. I can add a note, but two explanations in the paragraph might turn the adaptation into a local trivia lesson.
There are other ways to say the same thing. If the topic is new to you, read the example and then try to repeat it without looking.
Há quanto tempo Lia trabalha no local?: How long has Lia worked at the place?
Há também after. A campanha veio antes,: There is also after. The campaign came first, but the graph does not prove cause. Deadline change and another informative event occurred in the period. Should I raise this now or would accumulating corrections make it harder to follow?
There is a little milk in the fridge.
There is a library near my house.
Há, mas exige duas trocas e chega depois: There is, but it requires two transfers and arrives after nine. A taxi from here would cost more than the room. Shall we call the inn before deciding? Maybe they can arrange a late arrival.
Hábitos antigos, anterioridade e relatos: Old habits, anteriority, and more precise reports.
I agree aceita uma opinião; I see your p: I agree accepts an opinion; I see your point acknowledges the argument without necessarily accepting everything. Add but for a reservation and a concrete reason. Avoid interpreting a polite expression as full agreement.
I am agree está incorreto: agree é verbo: I am agree is incorrect: agree is a verb. Use I agree or I don't agree.
I ate at the market informa o local. Bou: I ate at the market informs the place. Bought describes the second action.
I can finish the check by four não prome: I can finish the check by four does not promise to finish the repair by four. Translating check as repair removes the decisive condition of the conversation.
I can see the playful intention. Someone: I can see the playful intention. Someone who doesn't know the history might hear an accusation of hoarding, though, especially if they returned everything already. The humor relies on a shared understanding that the organizers sometimes forget cables too. That background isn't actually in the message.
I cannot comment não deve substituir uma: I cannot comment should not replace an answer you have. Limit the information that is really unavailable and answer the rest.
I combina com am. Reading fornece a form: I combines with am. Reading provides the -ing form.
I didn't mean that esclarece intenção, m: I didn't mean that clarifies intention, but alone does not acknowledge the consequence of the wording. A full repair includes what happened and how it will be corrected.
I disagree with you refere-se à pessoa o: I disagree with you refers to the person or opinion; I disagree about the deadline indicates the subject. Avoid I am disagree.
I don't never walk cria uma dupla negaçã: I don't never walk creates a double negative outside the taught standard. Use I never walk or I don't walk.
I have been in London também existe, mas: I have been in London also exists, but it is not the same construction as visit with to. In this lesson, compare been to and gone to.
I have from Brazil does not express origin. In English, country names and nationalities start with a capital letter.
I have seen it yesterday mistura o prese: I have seen it yesterday mixes present perfect with yesterday. Use I saw it yesterday.
I haven't never tried usa duas marcas ne: I haven't never tried uses two negative marks. In the taught standard, say I have never tried or I haven't tried.
I kept calls from family and direct mess: I kept calls from family and direct messages from my project group. I silenced shopping apps and general social updates. For the first two days, I still reached for the phone out of habit. The quieter screen didn't immediately change the behavior.
I like a sandwich descreve gosto, não um: I like a sandwich describes a taste, not a specific request. To order, use I'd like or Can I have.
I like of music copia a preposição do po: I like of music copies the Portuguese preposition. Like does not require of before the object.
I mean pode introduzir uma reformulação;: I mean can introduce a reformulation; that is can make a reference more precise. Correcting your own speech is not, by itself, a lack of fluency. A brief correction helps the listener follow.
I noticed you corrected the premise with: I noticed you corrected the premise without abandoning the whole answer. That sounded more convincing than pretending the counterexample didn't matter. What structure were you using? Your response had a clear direction, but it didn't feel like you were forcing the question into a memorized introduction, three points and a conclusion regardless of relevance.
I ordered informa o pedido anterior; wit: I ordered informs the previous order; without milk preserves the detail. It is not necessary to accuse the attendant.
I recommend you to book não é o padrão t: I recommend you to book is not the standard worked on. Use I recommend booking or I recommend that you book.
I see the benefit, but we would need ano: I see the benefit, but we would need another week to test it. A reservation identifies the problem, without attacking the person.
I see your point não precisa significar: I see your point does not have to mean I agree with everything. Listen: I see your point, but the deadline still worries me. I acknowledge the idea and explain a concrete concern. Now try: an advantage first, a reservation after.
I see your point reconhece o raciocínio: I see your point acknowledges someone's reasoning; it does not promise agreement. Adding a specific reservation makes the disagreement useful. The phrase alone does not guarantee politeness: avoid an ironic tone.
I think apresenta a opinião; because it: I think expresses an opinion; because it saves time explains why.
I think introduz uma opinião. Because ac: I think introduces an opinion. Because adds the reason. Differentiate opinion from fact: I think this plan is better shows that it is your evaluation.
I think marca uma avaliação pessoal; acc: I think marks a personal evaluation; according to identifies the source of information. Might and probably indicate uncertainty to different degrees, without guaranteeing the outcome. Separate the observed data from the interpretation you make of it.
I was hoping indica uma expectativa ou p: I was hoping indicates an expectation or request; it does not show prior consent. A disappointed tone also does not prove an intention to manipulate.
I was study omite -ing. Nem toda ação lo: I was study omits -ing. Not every long action requires the continuous form: choose this form when you want to show the process in progress.
I will finish until Friday não é a forma: I will finish until Friday is not the usual way to express a deadline. Use finish by Friday; work until Friday describes working up to then.
I é o sujeito que vai usar a caneta. Me: I is the subject who will use the pen. Me is the object; my is possessive.
I'd contrai I would; depois de would, us: I'd contract I would; after would, use a base form like.
I'd like significa 'eu gostaria' e serve: I'd like means 'I would like' and is used for requests. It can come before a noun: I'd like a sandwich. Please softens the request. Can I have…? is also common when ordering in a café or restaurant.
I'd like to book… requests a reservation. For two nights indicates the length of stay. From…to… sets dates. Ask Is breakfast included? to check services. Double room usually means a room with a double bed; twin room usually has two single beds.
I'd like to make an appointment solicita: I'd like to make an appointment requests a time slot. Reschedule means to rearrange; cancel means to cancel. Are you available…? checks availability. When confirming, repeat day and time to avoid misunderstandings.
I'd rather cook informa a preferência; a: I'd rather cook states the preference; the next sentence gives two reasons.
I'd rather to walk está incorreto neste: I'd rather to walk is incorrect in this pattern. Compare prefer to walk, which uses a different structure.
I'll carry one for you é uma oferta imed: I'll carry one for you is an immediate offer of help.
I'll to help acrescenta um to desnecessá: I'll to help adds an unnecessary to. I'll help is an offer, it doesn't need to mean a prior plan.
I'm going visit omite to. I going to vis: I'm going to visit omite too. I am going to visit omite am. Going to requires both parts in standard writing.
I'm meeting não precisa estar acontecend: I'm meeting doesn't need to be happening right now. Read the marker tomorrow/on Thursday to interpret the tense.
I'm preparing the summary for colleagues: I'm preparing the summary for colleagues who weren't there. Would you keep move the goalposts and explain it, or replace it entirely? I don't want to flatten the coordinator's objection into a neutral statement that some paperwork changed. She was making a fairness argument, and that evaluative force is part of what the summary needs to preserve.
I'm reúne o sujeito I e o verbo am. Só I: I'm combines the subject I and the verb am. Just I leaves the sentence without a verb.
I'm running late avisa que você vai se a: I'm running late tells that you will be late without needing to explain every detail. To propose an alternative, use could we meet at… instead? and confirm with Would six thirty work for you? Here would makes the question more polite; it doesn't talk about the past. Finish with a concrete action, like I'll text you when I arrive, to keep the other person informed.
I'm seeing the dentist at nine apresenta: I'm seeing the dentist at nine presents the appointment scheduled for tomorrow.
I'm writing a message is the stated action. The question about studying receives a negative answer.
I've been knowing her não é a forma padr: I've been knowing her is not the standard way to say knowing someone; use I've known her. The continuous tense doesn't work for every verb.
Ideias centrais, inferências sustentadas: Central ideas, supported inferences, register, and organized texts.
Identifique primeiro a ideia principal d: First identify the main idea of the examples. Then, observe how to add details and prepare your own sentence on the same subject.
Identifiquei mecanismo e alvo do humor?: Did I identify the mechanism and target of the humor?
Identifiquei o que cada metáfora destaca: Did I identify what each metaphor highlights and hides?
If I had e would visit constroem uma sit: If I had and would visit create an imagined situation, without a confirmed date.
If I would have more time não é a forma: If I would have more time is not the standard form for this condition. Would stays in the result: I would learn.
If it will rain é inadequado para essa c: If it will rain is inappropriate for this standard condition. Portuguese uses 'se chover', but English uses present after if.
If we would have checked não é a forma p: If we would have checked is not the standard form of this condition. Put had checked in the if clause.
Imagine perder um trem e ouvir: Great, a: Imagine missing a train and hearing: Great, another delay. It could be irony, but the word alone doesn't solve it. Consider the situation and intonation. If in doubt, ask: Do you mean that literally? Good interpretation also means knowing how to confirm.
Imagine três objetos numa sala. Escreva: Imagine three objects in a room. Write where they are using in, on, and under.
Imagine uma loja e escreva uma frase com: Imagine a store and write one sentence with this and another with those. Adjust is/are to the number of objects.
Implicaturas dependem de contexto e pode: Implicatures depend on context and can be canceled by clarification. Certainly ambitious alone doesn't determine praise or reservation. Presuppositions can appear within a thank you: delighted you support assumes support. To respond accurately, keep textual observation, attitude inference, and operational commitment separate.
Improvisar com uma estrutura que se sust: Improvise with a structure that holds up
Improvisação avançada combina seleção e: Advanced improvisation combines selection and revisability. Respond to the implicit decision, choose a functional distinction, and make the consequence explicit. When receiving a counterexample, adjust the scope instead of repeating the statement. Fluency includes useful pauses, repairs, and proportional closure; speed and word count don't replace relevance.
Imputes indica atribuir algo a alguém. V: Imputes means to attribute something to someone. Verifies would confirm, and retracts would withdraw a previous attribution.
In indica dentro; on indica sobre uma su: In means inside; on means on a surface; under means beneath. The structure The keys are on the table locates a known object. Compare with There are keys on the table, which presents the existence of keys.
In itself delimita o que uma evidência d: In itself delimits what evidence demonstrates by itself; it doesn't deny that the sessions took place.
In itself significa por si só e delimita: In itself means by itself and delimits what the example can demonstrate.
In terms of é a expressão que introduz o: In terms of is the expression that introduces the comparison criterion; on and at are not used in this phrase.
Incerteza não significa que qualquer res: Uncertainty doesn't mean any result is possible. Show the relevant range and practical effect, instead of just saying the numbers might be wrong.
Inclua a data de revisão e quem reunirá: Include the review date and who will gather the responses. Without this, collecting opinions may seem like participation without influencing the decision. Few complaints won't automatically prove satisfaction: maybe people don't know the channel or don't feel comfortable using it.
Inclua a lista de itens aceitos e o link: Include the list of accepted items and the booking link. People should describe the problem first. Let me check the practical data, especially schedules: my memory of last month isn't reliable enough to publish this.
Inclua entregas, acessibilidade e a evid: Include deliveries, accessibility, and the evidence that would change your decision.
Incluí como avaliar o acesso real?: Did I include how to assess actual access?
Incluí responsável e prazo?: Did I include who is responsible and the deadline?
Increased indica o crescimento da presen: Increased indicates the growth of presence mentioned in the text.
Indiquei a perspectiva que falta?: Did I indicate the missing perspective?
Inferir é conectar indícios do texto, nã: To infer is to connect clues from the text, not to add unsupported facts. Expressions like seems and probably make it clear that there is interpretation. If the text does not provide a date, name, or reason, acknowledge the limit instead of filling in with imagination.
Information não recebe plural nem a/an n: Information does not take plural or a/an in this usage.
Information é não contável: some informa: Information is uncountable: some information, not informations. To ask for details, details can be plural.
Informe uma idade inteira entre 4 e 120: Enter a whole age between 4 and 120 years.
Informei a linha de base e o denominador: Did I provide the baseline and denominator?
Inglês para falantes de português do Bra: English for Brazilian Portuguese speakers. Explanations in PT-BR, examples and practice in English.
Instalar Sparky English no celular: Install Sparky English on your phone
Integral indica elemento essencial ao se: Integral indicates an essential element to the meaning. Incidental and redundant would suggest the condition is secondary or dispensable.
Integrar fontes, calibrar certeza e prod: Integrate sources, calibrate certainty, and produce structured arguments for demanding audiences.
Integrei as fontes por tema?: Did I integrate the sources by theme?
Integrei fontes sem apagar seus limites?: Did I integrate sources without erasing their limits?
Integrei interesses sem confundi-los com: Did I integrate interests without confusing them with facts?
Interested on copia uma combinação inade: Interested on copies is an inappropriate combination. The preposition does not come from a word-for-word translation from Portuguese.
