The passage permits two readings, but th: The passage permits two readings, but the final qualification favors the narrower one.
The person who she called me duplica o s: The person who she called me duplicates the subject if the intention is 'the person who called me.' Use the person who called me.
The phrase got them on board also places: The phrase got them on board also places our team at the center of the story and the partners in the role of people persuaded to join it. Was the pilot actually co-designed? If so, the wording underplays their contribution as well as overstating the scope of agreement. We need to distinguish celebration from ownership of the process.
The public event must finish at nine, wi: The public event must finish at nine, with the remaining half-hour reserved for clearing the room and staff checks. Extending the public program would require an additional staffing arrangement that I can't authorize within the standard hire. I can discuss options, but I don't want to imply that a later finish is available simply because the building's final closing time sounds flexible.
The rate fell from 80% to 75%, a decreas: The rate fell from 80% to 75%, a decrease of five ___.
The report had solved everything, natura: The report had solved everything, naturally. No one would object to the new route once they understood the elegant model behind it. Mara closed the document and looked through the window at the queue forming beside the old stop. The passage slips from an official claim into language colored by Mara's skepticism. 'Naturally' may mimic the committee's confidence, while the visible queue quietly resists it. Treating the first two sentences as the novelist's direct policy view would erase the tension among institutional language, character perspective and narrated scene.
The reports measured identical programme: The reports measured identical programs and identical outcomes.
The reports need not be inconsistent: on: The reports need not be inconsistent: one concerns satisfaction among attendees, whereas the other covers waiting times for all arrivals. A broader trial should track both measures in comparable groups. Even then, differences between branches may limit how confidently the results can be generalized.
The reviewer approved the organisation’s: The reviewer approved the organization’s response
There are two shops informa explicitamen: There are two shops explicitly inform two stores.
There is apresenta um item singular; the: There is presents a singular item; there are presents plural items. The structure expresses existence, like 'há' or 'tem' in informal Portuguese. In questions, invert be: Is there a bank? Are there shops?
There were sixty starters last term and: There were sixty starters last term and eighty this term. So the rates are eighty percent and seventy-five percent respectively. That means the completion rate fell by five percentage points, even though the number of completions rose. Calling it a twenty-five percent improvement without naming the measure would be misleading.
These is mistura plural e singular. Shoe: These is a mix of plural and singular. Shoes is plural: these shoes are.
They exige were; waiting fornece a ação: They requires were; waiting provides the ongoing action.
They waiting omite are. They are wait om: They waiting omits are. They are wait omits -ing. Both parts are necessary in the present continuous.
Thirty volunteers não garante trinta fun: Thirty volunteers does not guarantee thirty roles covered. The listening requires attention to distribution, not just the most memorable number.
This funciona como sujeito singular e co: This functions as a singular subject and matches with is.
This indica um item próximo; that, um it: This indicates a nearby item; that, a more distant item. In plural, use these and those. Combine this/that with is and these/those with are. The distance can be physical or how you point something out in conversation.
This is Lia's atribui a bolsa à Lia; min: This is Lia's assigns the bag to Lia; mine is green describes Ana's bag.
This is apresenta alguém próximo: This i: This introduces someone nearby: This is my friend. He and she can refer back to a person when their pronouns are known. It can refer back to an object. The affirmative sentence needs a subject and verb: She is a teacher.
This sozinho pode apontar para mais de u: This alone can point to more than one idea. Add a precise noun, like this discrepancy or this assumption.
Those e over there apontam para os sapat: Those and over there point to the more distant shoes.
Three bags são três bolsas; two boxes sã: Three bags are three bags; two boxes are two boxes.
Three chairs é plural, por isso a estrut: Three chairs is plural, so the structure is there are.
Thursday at ten é oferecido e aceito com: Thursday at ten is offered and accepted with That works.
Ticket acceptance is confirmed, but the: Ticket acceptance is confirmed, but the optional stopover remains ___.
To sum up é um sinalizador de resumo ou: To sum up is a summary or conclusion signpost, suitable for returning to the main recommendation.
Todo pronome tem referente claro?: Does every pronoun have a clear referent?
Told pode receber me diretamente. Said e: Told can receive me directly. Said would require said to me in this structure.
Tons de amora e rosa suave para dar outr: Shades of blackberry and soft pink to give your writing space a different look.
Too + adjetivo indica excesso que cria u: Too + adjective indicates excess that creates a limit: too expensive. Enough comes after the adjective: warm enough, but before the noun: enough money. Not enough indicates insufficiency. Enough to + verb explains the possible action.
Too large descreve o tamanho excessivo;: Too large describes excessive size; the dialogue does not mention a password or empty file.
Too significa 'também' e aparece no fim:: Too means 'also' and appears at the end: Nice to meet you too!
Toque nas palavras abaixo para montar a: Tap the words below to build the sentence.
Traduzi a incerteza em consequência prát: Did I translate the uncertainty into practical consequence?
Traduzir don't have to como 'não pode' m: Translating don't have to as 'não pode' changes the rule. It means 'does not need to'.
Traduzir uma referência sem apagar sua f: Translating a reference without weakening its force
Tradução pragmática preserva função, rel: Pragmatic translation preserves function, relationship, and effect, even when the literal form needs to change. For humor or irony, identify the target, mechanism, and social risk. Choose between recreating the effect, making the reference explicit, or accepting a controlled loss; then check if the new version maintains the register and does not change who is ridiculed.
Transforme duas perguntas diretas em ped: Turn two direct questions into requests with Could you tell me or Do you know. Review the internal order.
Transforme uma frase em pergunta e respo: Turn a sentence into a question and answer without consulting the model: Were Lia and Omar at home?
Trinta pessoas se ofereceram para o even: Thirty people volunteered for Saturday's event. Great, but almost all want to take care of a booth. We still need people at the entrance and to keep the paths clear.
Trocar não sei autorizar por foi proibid: Replacing I don't know if I can authorize with it was forbidden changes the decision status. Preserve absence of confirmation without turning it into permission or denial.
Trocaria a manchete, publicaria números: I would change the headline, publish numbers with their reach, and make the follow-up explicit. I would keep the original report linked to a dated correction, making the change visible. Correcting should improve the record, not pretend the excessive claim never existed.
Troque I por she e reconte duas ações de: Replace I with she and retell two memory actions. Does the past change? Explain your decision before checking the rule.
Troque uma expressão vaga, como soon, po: Replace a vague expression, like soon, with a clear deadline during your answer.
Try on é a expressão usada para experime: Try on is the expression used to try on clothes.
Tuesday é um dia da semana; use on Tuesd: Tuesday is a day of the week; use on Tuesday. In is used with months and at with times.
Turn off it não é a ordem padrão com pro: Turn off it is not the standard order with pronouns. Use turn it off. Do not transfer this separation to all phrasal verbs.
Turn right é a instrução explícita; oppo: Turn right is the explicit instruction; opposite the park locates the station after the turn.
Two box deixa de marcar o plural. Em ing: Two box stops marking the plural. In standard English, children is already plural; do not write childrens.
Two waters pode aparecer como pedido abr: Two waters can appear as an abbreviated request for two servings, but the explicit structure to start with is two bottles of water. Bread does not become breads to count slices.
Um argumento equilibrado distingue a pos: A balanced argument distinguishes the main position from its conditions. Although introduces a concessive clause; nevertheless connects a conclusion that holds despite the objection. Prefer a qualified statement to a universal promise and explain why the caveat does not negate your proposal.
Um argumento resistente responde à melho: A robust argument responds to the best version of the objection, not the easiest. Even a legitimate criticism may not be decisive if another criterion prevails; explain this comparison. If the objection changes your recommendation, state the revision transparently. Specific concessions are more informative than a generic balancing formula.
Um arquivo achava a digitalização quase: A file thought digitization was nearly complete because it had scanned boxes. Only after review did it discover missing descriptions: images existed, but researchers could not locate them well. The leader included quality and usable metadata in the criteria. The review redefined the conclusion without erasing the work done. The next step focused on descriptions and user testing.
Um artigo dizia que oficinas públicas se: An article said public workshops always attracted more people when free. A project recorded a drop after removing fees but also moved to a less accessible building. The case did not prove that charging increased attendance; it showed that price was not the only factor and that always was too strong. The revised thesis considered price, location, schedules, and audience.
Um briefing transforma análise em decisã: A briefing turns analysis into decision without hiding dissent. State the question, summarize converging and conflicting evidence, indicate limits, and present options with consequences. The recommendation should follow explicit criteria and include signals that would justify revision, so confidence is not confused with inflexibility.
Um centro cultural e um grupo negociaram: A cultural center and a group negotiated use of a hall: weekly sessions and a three-month trial, with permanent access dependent on accessibility and staff costs. The group would collect feedback; the center would publish usage. They agreed on a review in six weeks and notice to both coordinators for schedule changes. The record did not promise permanent access.
Um centro pesquisou quem já frequentava: A center researched who already attended its classes. Most preferred evening sessions and some requested childcare. The coordinator highlighted both findings and costs. She also explained that those who could not attend were not represented. She recommended testing an evening session with childcare and outreach beyond the current list, then comparing participants.
Um colega pergunta Did you use to drive?: A colleague asks Did you use to drive? Answer orally and add information not in the text.
Um conselho citou uma pesquisa universit: A council cited a university survey to extend library hours. The study was reviewed and published the questions but consulted only registered users. It supports current users' preferences well, especially evening ones, and says little about other residents. The committee can use it if it correctly describes the sample and seeks additional evidence before speaking for the whole neighborhood.
Um conserto concluído no dia não equival: A repair completed on the day does not equal lasting use.
Um conserto que não resolveu: A repair that did not fix the problem
Um contraexemplo testa o alcance de uma: A counterexample tests the scope of a statement. If the thesis says always, a contrary case may require revision; if it says often under these conditions, the case needs to be compared to the conditions. Reformulate the thesis to reflect the evidence, without creating arbitrary exceptions just to make it unchallengeable.
Um distrito considera aulas noturnas gra: A district considers free evening classes. Records show demand, interviews reveal transport barriers, and a small test suggests better retention with vouchers. The test had no comparison group and covered two centers. The briefing recommends a pilot in four centers, public rules, comparison with similar centers, and reviews at eight and twenty-four weeks, serving more students while improving evidence.
Um ensaio defende ouvir toda reclamação,: An essay argues for listening to every complaint but warns against giving all priority to the loudest voices. One reader sees contradiction; another distinguishes recognition from automatic service. The ending calls for public reasons to refuse requests, without promising to accept all. The weight of competing needs remains open. It is possible to defend the principle's coherence and criticize the lack of explicit decision procedure.
Um ensaio sobre urbanismo se chama 'Um t: An essay on urbanism is titled 'A roof of your own, at market price.' Those who recognize the previous phrase anticipate space, independence, and exclusion; the commercial complement turns aspiration into an access issue. Since the source is not named, universal recognition or full intent cannot be proven. Still, the phrase frames private space as ideal and commodity, a tension developed in the text.
Um estudo de organizações grandes associ: A study of large organizations associated structured mentoring with retention in some departments. Managers participated voluntarily, which could favor teams already committed to development. Small organizations might not have the same resources. A headline promised to prevent departures in any company. The editor asked to preserve the positive association and recover the caveats.
Um evento que caiba no bairro: An event that fits in the neighborhood
Um grupo imprimiu um livreto sem conferi: A group printed a booklet without checking the final file. A page with emergency contacts was missing. The error was noticed before distribution and the printer added a sheet at no cost. They decided that two people would check future files with a checklist. They acknowledged that prior checking would have avoided the delay, without stating that the error caused an emergency.
Um limite colaborativo combina reconheci: A collaborative boundary combines recognition, unequivocal statement of availability, and an executable alternative. I appreciate…, but… does not cancel the following refusal. Provided introduces a necessary condition: the solution works as long as it preserves citation approval. When summarizing the agreement, keep conditions and responsible parties; omitting them turns a limited proposal into an open promise.
Um morador disse que o pátio estava fica: A resident said the yard was becoming unusable. Another said complaints prevented all community activity. Repeating this as fact would polarize the summary, but removing everything would hide the meeting's purpose. How to represent concerns fairly?
Um museu registrou menos consultas após: A museum recorded fewer inquiries after changing the platform. The staff thought interest had dropped, but an audit found calls that failed to enter the database. Attendance was stable and comparable call counts were missing. The analyst concluded that part of the apparent drop could reflect the record, without ruling out a real drop or considering it the main explanation.
Um parecer conecta evidência heterogênea: An opinion connects heterogeneous evidence to a situated decision. Start with the decision problem and differentiate facts, interests, and criteria. Your conclusion can be conditional without being evasive: specify what to do now and what will depend on future data. A busy reader should be able to locate recommendation, justification, and main risk.
Um parágrafo pode apresentar uma ideia c: A paragraph can present a central idea, explain it, give an example, and conclude. Connectors should show real relations: for example illustrates; therefore presents consequence. Avoid repeating the same noun when a pronoun has a clear reference.
Um pedido simples deve dizer o motivo do: A simple request should state the reason for contact, the needed information, and a polite closing. Could you send me…? makes a request. I look forward to your reply expresses expectation of response; it is not a demand for immediate return.
Um pedido útil inclui o problema, o que: A useful request includes the problem, what you have already tried, and the help desired. I've tried… shows prior attempt. Could you show me how to…? asks for a demonstration. Avoid a vague request when you can already describe the difficulty.
Um plano completo informa objetivo, rest: A complete plan informs objective, constraints, choice, and next steps. Combine comparisons, reasons, and conditions without stacking unnecessary structures. Review if each promise has a responsible party and deadline. A good text allows the reader to act with the information provided.
Um programa se descreveu como esteira qu: A program described itself as a treadmill that led students to employment. The image conveyed movement and destination but minimized pauses, changes, and return for support. Completion numbers were not contested; the discussion was about what counted as a successful trajectory. Changing the metaphor alone would not improve the service, but analyzing it exposed assumptions relevant to funding and nonlinear progress.
Um projeto de resolução conecta evidênci: A draft resolution connects evidence, hypothesis, action, and evaluation criteria. As long as establishes a condition to accept a proposal. Even if introduces a possible situation that does not eliminate the idea's validity. Choose indicators linked to the objective: number of repairs and usefulness of learning measure different things.
Um projeto editorial articula informação: An editorial project articulates confirmed information, attributed perspective, and declared gap. Reported speech allows conveying speech without turning it into the narrator's guarantee. Hasn't received indicates absence of funding so far; will consider indicates future analysis, not approval. Review the effect of your wording on someone unfamiliar with the context.
Um quadro pendurado na superfície da par: A frame hung on the wall surface is on the wall.
Um relato de melhora após várias mudança: A report of improvement after several changes does not prove which caused the result. Avoid turning helped into solved everyone's problem.
Um relato eficaz apresenta expectativa,: An effective report presents expectation, decisive event, and reflection. Past perfect situates what happened before another past point: I'd offered. Was about to shows an action about to happen that may have been interrupted. Choose tenses to guide chronology but also explain why the episode changed your perspective.
Um relatório encontrou maior presença de: A report found greater presence of remote employees in optional training during a twelve-week test. A bulletin turned the association into 'working from home makes everyone learn more.' The editor corrected because the period was short, presence did not equal learning, and participation was voluntary. The final version said flexible hours may have helped participants attend more.
Um relatório registrou oito incidentes c: A report recorded eight bicycle incidents, against four the previous year. A campaign spoke of a 100% increase; the official response, of only four extra cases. Both selected a scale. Since trips also grew 60%, the rate per thousand trips rose less. The analyst showed counts, percentage, and exposure, noting concentration at two intersections.
Um responsável precisa confirmar para co: A responsible person needs to confirm to continue.
Um resumo de decisões registra quem fará: A decision summary records who will do what and by when. We agreed to… indicates agreement. Ana will… assigns the action. Avoid confusing a discussed suggestion with an accepted decision. Use deadline markers to make the summary verifiable.
Um serviço anunciou desconto para client: A service announced a discount for current customers who switched to an annual plan by the end of the month. Monthly customers who kept their plans would pay the usual amount. A colleague summarized it as a discount for everyone. The manager asked for revision preserving condition and deadline. The language could be simpler but needed to describe the same offer.
Um terceiro conseguiria executar o acord: Could a third party execute the agreement?
Um terraço junto ao rio, entre flores e: A terrace by the river, among flowers and sunset reflections.
Uma abertura mitigada pode organizar o t: A mitigated opening can organize the turn without weakening a factual correction. Separate the diplomatic entry from the unequivocal statement and calibrate the certainty of each point. After marks sequence, not causality. After an accepted correction, close the repair and resume the discussion's purpose, avoiding turning it into a reprimand.
Uma adaptação entre públicos pode variar: An adaptation between audiences can vary tone, explanation, and familiarity but must maintain commitments and conditions. Metaphors of adherence and victory also distribute authorship and agency. Compare versions to detect reality changes disguised as style. Before publishing, a representation check verifies if parties recognize their role and the agreement.
Uma adaptação pode ser válida, mas reque: An adaptation can be valid but requires its own justification instead of rewriting success retrospectively.
Uma afirmação responsável pode mudar de: A responsible statement can change form without changing strength. Hedging with suggests, appears to, and is consistent with signals the evidence's scope. When adapting text, preserve who was observed, the period, and degree of certainty; simplifying vocabulary does not authorize turning association into cause or trend into rule.
Uma alternativa pode ser verdadeira e ai: An alternative can be true and still not summarize the text. Check if it explains the whole, not just one sentence.
Uma alusão convoca outro texto, evento o: An allusion summons another text, event, or cultural formula without fully explaining it. Identify the lexical echo, test the necessary knowledge, and ask what contrast it creates in the new context. A solid reading distinguishes probable effect from proven origin and remains understandable even when the reference remains uncertain.
Uma avaliação comparável ajuda a disting: A comparable evaluation helps distinguish effects and costs. Excluding unscheduled services would erase an important part of the service.
Uma ação em andamento no passado: An ongoing action in the past
Uma biblioteca comparou dois sistemas. A: A library compared two systems. A cost less to install and worked on old computers, but weekly reports were manual. B automated reports and offered better accessibility, though it required new equipment. With limited budget and only one administrator, the committee asked for three-year estimates and demonstrations with screen reader users before choosing.
Uma cidade deve decidir sobre transporte: A city must decide on a pilot transport. Operators report reliability, residents value nighttime activities, and audit questions subsidy distribution. Data exclude those who do not reach stops; interviews represent frequent users. Canceling removes benefit; maintaining equal may preserve inequality. Without waiting for perfect evidence, the council can change routes, set review, and publish reasons. The recommendation should integrate partial perspectives.
Uma cidade testou uma área de pedestres: A city tested a pedestrian area for four weekends. Shopkeepers reported higher sales on Saturdays, but deliveries were delayed and two accessible spots were removed. The council suggested making the project permanent immediately. A residents' group preferred a longer test: they wanted weekday data and replacement accessible spots before deciding. The representative considered results promising but insufficient to predict the whole year.
Uma cliente devolveu uma luminária danif: A customer returned a damaged lamp and was promised a replacement in five business days. After eight, she had no tracking. The attendant offered immediate refund or shipment the next morning. She chose refund because the event had already occurred and asked for written confirmation of the amount and processing time.
Uma comissão disse que nem todos os pedi: A committee said not all late requests were rejected. Commentators turned this into acceptance of all. The text only allowed saying some avoided rejection, without indicating if they were accepted, postponed, or returned for clarification. The revised version separated results and criteria, as candidates acted based on a nonexistent guarantee.
Uma comparação útil mantém os mesmos cri: A useful comparison keeps the same criteria for all options. Whereas contrasts clauses; in terms of delimits the evaluated aspect. One option may have the lowest initial cost and the highest maintenance cost. Make explicit the weight of criteria before announcing the best result to avoid selective comparison.
Uma conclusão de nível no app não equiva: A level completion in the app does not equal CEFR certification. This task practices reading and writing; listening and speaking require other activities.
Uma conclusão defensável deve incorporar: A defensible conclusion must incorporate uncertainty without giving up judgment.
Uma coordenadora precisava de feedback a: A coordinator needed feedback by Thursday. To a close colleague, she briefly asked to check the budget that day. To an external reviewer, she gave context, indicated sections, and deadline. Both were polite but offered different context according to the recipient's knowledge. The external message also asked for immediate notice if the deadline was unfeasible.
Uma correção eficaz começa pelo fato ver: An effective correction starts with the verifiable fact, explains the gap, and repeats the correct conclusion. Avoid turning the rumor into the headline or repeating it many times. If there is a true part, acknowledge it precisely before showing why it does not support the misleading conclusion. Include a source the public can check.
Uma crítica comparativa de nível C2 form: A comparative critique at C2 level formulates a productive criterion, brings texts closer without erasing genre differences, and revises its thesis in light of the best objection. Integrate microscopic language analysis and broader consequences. In oral defense, respond to the exact point, reformulate under pressure, and acknowledge a limitation without abandoning supported judgment.
Uma data como 04/05 pode ser interpretad: A date like 04/05 can be interpreted as May 4 or April 5. Write 4 May or May 4 when in doubt.
Uma defesa final deve tornar a decisão c: A final defense must make the decision clear and revisable. Compare alternatives by the problem they solve, make conditions explicit before evaluating results, and preserve the record when there is an exception. Qualifications only help if they delimit actions; accumulating them without a readable proposal becomes evasion. An unexpected finding can justify a new decision without rewriting previous criteria.
Uma designer ofereceu entregar o folheto: A designer offered to deliver the brochure on Friday instead of Wednesday if the client approved the text by Monday. The client accepted Monday but requested three extra pages. She explained that the extension covered only the current eight pages; extras would require a new budget. They agreed on eight pages for Friday and a separate supplement later. The deadline changed; the current workload did not.
Uma dica de conversa: I am pode virar I’: A conversation tip: I am can become I’m. Listen: I’m ready. I am ready! The full form is also correct and can add emphasis. Now say your name both ways, without rushing.
Uma editora substituiu uma frase carrega: An editor replaced a phrase heavy with nominalizations with a direct clause in which the committee evaluated the possibility of extension. However, she preserved the condition of team approval, as removing it would change a conditional recommendation into an absolute promise. The goal was to separate verbal weight from information that legitimately limits interpretation.
Uma entrevista que vai além do sim: An interview that goes beyond yes
Uma equipe relatou projeções sensíveis a: A team reported projections sensitive to land use assumptions. For specialists, it compared scenarios and parameters. For residents, it explained that different building plans would produce distinct projected patterns and that maps did not predict a specific storm. The public version used a known street and maintained uncertainty, without exactly predicting each house's next winter.
Uma escola propôs publicar todos os avis: A school proposed publishing all homework notices in an app. A guardian objected that some families shared a phone and had unstable internet. The principal first spoke of convenience, without solving access. The revised proposal kept weekly printed notices without requiring justification. The guardian supported the revision, asking the school to verify if the information really reached families.
Uma exceção exige nova justificativa, nã: An exception requires new justification, not retrospective change of criteria.
Uma experiência individual não refuta au: An individual experience does not automatically refute the average; the average also does not invalidate the experience. They are different scales of observation.
Uma explicação mais simples não precisa: A simpler explanation does not need to be less precise.
Uma expressão reconhecível pode parecer: A recognizable expression may seem more precise than it is. Recovering the turn it responds to prevents expanding a local objection into a general prohibition.
Uma expressão retórica como endlessly nã: A rhetorical expression like endlessly does not amount to proof of infinite duration or definitive intention. Attribute the evaluation and maintain the events that support it.
Uma faculdade quer reduzir filas no almo: A college wants to reduce lunch lines. One proposal adds a counter; another alternates the end of classes. The first requires equipment and staff; the second affects those who travel together. Lines were only measured on two very busy days. The committee should recommend a next step, consult those affected, and define evidence to maintain the change, without assuming equal benefit for all.
Uma frase pode comunicar mais que sua pr: A sentence can communicate more than its explicit proposition. Even, merely, and at least guide expectations; their removal changes attitude or implicature. Reviewing tone requires observing the relationship between evaluation, evidence, and recipient. Making a text professional does not mean neutralizing all authorial voice, but aligning its effect with the purpose.
A plausible inference is not certainty. Separate 'the text says' from 'the text suggests'.
Uma inferência plausível não é leitura d: A plausible inference is not mind reading. Use seems to be asking when the text does not explicitly confirm the intention.
Uma janela estrelada, livros e luz de le: A starry window, books, and reading light for your study companion.
Uma manchete diz que a cidade resgata me: One headline says the city rescues a market in crisis with public money; another says public investment protects two hundred jobs. Both deal with the same subsidy. The first highlights rescue, failure, and the source of the money; the second calls the decision an investment, highlights jobs, and reduces the visibility of the beneficiary. Neither alone decides if the measure is justified; each directs attention to different costs and criteria.
Uma narrativa de dados seleciona ordem,: A data narrative selects order, comparison, and scale; therefore, it is never neutral. Start with the question and the relevant denominator. Highlight absolute and relative change when they produce different impressions, explain the baseline, and do not let an isolated case carry a trend that the whole set does not show.
Uma pausa breve prejudicaria a impressão: Would a brief pause harm the impression of fluency? Sometimes speakers fill the first seconds by saying the question is fascinating and enormously complex. Repeated always, it can sound like evasion, not useful thinking time.
Uma pausa curta seria aceitável. Fluênci: A short pause would be acceptable. Fluency should allow following the answer, not prevent thinking. If I need to clarify the decision, I ask a specific question. If I understand, I answer, qualify as necessary, and stop by offering a useful basis for the next turn.
Uma pergunta aberta convida a explicar u: An open question invites explaining a process; a follow-up question revisits something specific the interviewee said. Could you give an example… produces concrete evidence. In indirect questions, keep the affirmative order: Could you explain what a visitor does? Avoid adding direct question inversion inside it.
Uma pergunta carregada incorpora premiss: A loaded question incorporates debatable premises. Separate the legitimate concern from the embedded conclusion, briefly correct the latter, and respond to the former. Recognizing a specific flaw does not confirm the entire label associated with it. A precise reply maintains concrete responsibility and does not limit itself to exploring the easiest exaggeration of the question.
Uma pergunta difícil: por que desperdiça: A difficult question: why waste residents' money on another trendy pilot if the previous one yielded no results? The formulation is loaded, but there may be a legitimate concern. Respond without accepting the entire premise or using tone to ignore the expense.
Uma pergunta hostil com uma questão legí: A hostile question with a legitimate issue
Uma pergunta por vez. Suas escolhas fica: One question at a time. Your choices are saved in the account and can be changed later.
Uma pergunta sobre possibilidade pode fu: A question about possibility can function as a request, but the inference depends on context. Is there any chance… often softens a request; it does not make every question an order. Identify the suggested action, the relationship between people, and the possibility of refusal. Confirm intentions when there is more than one plausible reading.
Uma pesquisa regional estimou apoio entr: A regional survey estimated support between 62% and 68% for later buses. One newspaper announced exactly 65%; another said the uncertainty invalidated the study. The researcher explained that the range showed a majority and guided capacity but did not allow classifying small differences between districts. She recommended planning regional demand and expanding local samples.
Uma poltrona confortável e colinas pela: A comfortable armchair and hills by the window to learn in a travel atmosphere.
Uma produção de domínio discursivo integ: A discourse domain production integrates perspectives, controls assumptions, and responds to context changes without losing the thread. Plan the argument hierarchy and the conditions under which it would be revised. A good oral defense is not recitation: it reformulates, clarifies ambiguities, and responds to the specific objection just made.
Uma proposta de dados detalhados prometi: A detailed data proposal promised accountability. The strongest criticism supported transparency but pointed out indirect identification in small categories. Saying only that openness was valuable did not respond. The revision grouped categories and created detailed analysis under controlled conditions, reducing but not eliminating risk. It remained to discuss how much information could be removed without losing public utility.
Uma publicação dizia que a clínica fecha: A publication said the clinic would close forever. In reality, Saturday consultations were suspended for a month during electrical work; weekdays and referrals continued. The first response repeated the rumor prominently and circulated without the denial. The revised notice started with hours, explained the temporary change, linked the schedule, and offered a phone number to those affected.

É uma distinção importante. Remover um e: It is an important distinction. Removing a stimulus and changing a habit are not exactly the same thing. Did something help or was it enough to wait for the desire to decrease?

When the effect diverges from the intention, describe what you meant to communicate, acknowledge the effect, and rephrase. Explaining the joke does not replace repairing the interaction nor justify attributing the reaction to the person's nationality.
A necessidade na sexta torna o prazo do: The need on Friday makes the repair deadline inconvenient. The exchange will still be checked; showing the receipt does not mean automatic approval.
A pergunta transforma uma sugestão indir: The question turns an indirect suggestion into a bounded request. Sparky offers partial help and conditions the bigger commitment on negotiating priorities.
A primeira opção corrige a premissa sem: The first option corrects the premise without erasing the impact. The others use a formal distinction to disqualify the concern or promise openness that does not exist.
A reformulação pelo colega revela compre: The colleague's reformulation reveals understanding of two essential ideas. Liking the presentation does not demonstrate understanding, and this test does not validate the study sample.
Accessible não especifica todas as neces: Accessible does not specify all of a person's needs. Step-free refers to steps; it does not guarantee suitable bathrooms nor that all spaces will be open.
Accessible pode descrever uma explicação: Accessible can describe an understandable explanation without meaning superficial. Simplifying the order of information does not authorize removing a caveat that changes the conclusion.
Ajudaria se eu começasse pela descoberta: Would it help if I started with the discovery and explained the caveat afterward?
Analise pressupostos, ironia e reformula: Analyze assumptions, irony, and reformulations precisely, without inventing intentions.
Ao recomendar uma atividade, compare as: When recommending an activity, compare options by the same criteria and check incomplete information. "Be supposed to" indicates expectation or received information, not confirmation. "As long as" makes a condition explicit. A responsible recommendation separates building access from access to the entire route and asks the person what they prefer.
Apresente duas opções em dois minutos. S: Present two options in two minutes. Your interlocutor disagrees with your favorite: clarify the criteria and adapt the recommendation to their preference.
Avise um colega sobre um atraso em 45 se: Inform a colleague about a delay in 45 seconds. They propose another location: confirm which entrance and repeat the plan in your own words.
Be supposed to + verbo transmite uma exp: "Be supposed to + verb" conveys an expectation or received information. "To be" completes the structure and the second part signals that confirmation is still missing.
Come across as descreve a impressão prod: "Come across as" describes the impression produced. "Come up" and "come out" have other uses but do not complete this pattern with the meaning of sounding like a criticism.
Compromise pode significar chegar a um m: "Compromise" can mean reaching a middle ground, not promising something. A condition with "provided that" is not a guaranteed fact: it still needs to be fulfilled.
Conte um problema, confirme detalhes e c: Tell a problem, confirm details, and agree on solutions in everyday situations.
Contestar a premissa de uma pergunta: Challenging the premise of a question
Contestar um pressuposto não responde au: Challenging an assumption does not automatically respond to the questioner's concern. After clarifying the premise, address the concrete impact; precision can become evasion if you stop at reformulation.
Depois de would it be possible usamos to: After "would it be possible" we use "to + verb": "to exchange." The structure presents a possibility politely, without asserting a right already confirmed.

Ela contesta decidir por ele com base em: She challenges deciding for him based on an assumption. Checking details and having an alternative remain part of their plan.

Em três minutos, repare um comentário qu: In three minutes, repair a comment that was understood as disregard. Listen to the other's interpretation, acknowledge the effect, and explain the problem to a third party in a neutral register.
Em um atendimento, comece pelo produto e: In a service interaction, start with the product and the observable problem: it stops working after ten minutes. The simple past informs when you bought it; the present describes the usual defect. "Would it be possible to…?" makes a polite request. Explain what you have already tried so the other person does not repeat a useless solution.
Essa pergunta pressupõe que a decisão er: This question assumes the decision was final, and that is precisely what is under discussion.

Explique o defeito em um minuto sem dize: Explain the defect in one minute without just saying "it is broken." Respond to a service agent's suggestion and confirm the next step.

I'm late descreve um atraso atual; I'm g: "I'm late" describes a current delay; "I'm going to be late" predicts a delay. To notify someone, say "let you know," without adding "to" before "you."

Sparky: Could we talk about the evening: Sparky: Could we talk about the evening calls? I can hear them through the wall, and I've got early shifts this month. Pinky: I didn't realize they were keeping you up. My project partner is overseas, so earlier calls aren't always possible. Sparky: I don't want you to cancel them. Would using the living room help? Pinky: Probably, although the internet drops near the window. I could move the router and wear headphones. Sparky: I'm happy to compromise, provided that we agree on quiet hours after ten on work nights. Pinky: What about Tuesdays? Our only shared slot is ten thirty. Sparky: One planned exception would work if you let me know in advance. Let's try it for two weeks rather than making a permanent rule tonight. Pinky: Agreed. And if your shifts change, we'll check in again. I'd rather know there's a problem than assume the arrangement is working.
Sparky: The presentation is thorough, bu: Sparky: The presentation is thorough, but it could be more accessible. Pinky: Could you point to a section where you lost track? I'm not sure whether you mean the vocabulary or the structure. Sparky: The opening, mainly. You define three statistical terms before telling us what changed. I was trying to remember the definitions rather than follow your argument. Pinky: Would it help if I led with the finding and explained the caveat afterwards? Sparky: Yes, as long as afterwards doesn't mean burying it on the final slide. The sample was small, and people need to know that before acting on the result. Pinky: So I could say the pilot improved attendance, immediately add that we can't yet generalize, and then show how we measured it. Sparky: That would work. Keep the technical definitions in the notes for anyone who wants them. Pinky: I'll try the revised opening with a colleague outside our team. If they can explain both the finding and its limitation, we'll have a better indication that the change helped.

Pinky: I understood that you weren't pleased. What wasn't clear was whether you were criticizing the system or me for choosing it. Sparky: I hadn't considered that. What I meant as a joke came across as dismissive, and I can see why. I was frustrated with the repeated failures, not with your effort to find a solution. Pinky: I appreciate you saying that. During the meeting, I was already trying to explain the problem to a new colleague who didn't know the history. Your comment made that harder. Sparky: Would it help if I clarified it with them? Pinky: Briefly, yes. There's no need to turn it into a discussion about who understands our sense of humor. Just explain the concern and what we're doing next. Sparky: I'll say the system has failed twice this week, that we chose it on reasonable information, and that we're checking an alternative. Pinky: That gives them something useful. We can still joke together; I just need the criticism to be clear when other people are relying on us for an accurate explanation.
Speak at a confident conversational pace: Speak at a confident conversational pace, roughly 160–175 words per minute. Link words naturally, reduce unstressed function words, and vary sentence stress with meaning. Do not over-enunciate or pause after every phrase.
Speak like an engaged native speaker tal: Speak like an engaged native speaker talking to an adult peer, roughly 170–185 words per minute. Use connected speech, natural weak forms, expressive emphasis, and short thought-group pauses. Preserve meaningful contrast and negation; never rush mechanically.
Speak with fluent, spontaneous native co: Speak with fluent, spontaneous native conversational delivery, roughly 175–195 words per minute. Use subtle pragmatic emphasis, connected speech, and natural reductions, varying pace where the meaning calls for it. Preserve intelligibility; avoid exaggerated acting, artificial hesitations, or a newsreader cadence.

Uma pergunta pode embutir uma conclusão: A question can embed a disputable conclusion: 'when did you stop listening?' assumes you stopped listening. Address the legitimate issue without endorsing that premise. Distinguish fact, implication, and decision criteria; acknowledging impact doesn't require accepting a false description. Reformulate precisely and return to the practical question, avoiding nuances to evade responsibility.
Uma regra negociada distingue preferênci: A negotiated rule distinguishes preference, need, and condition. Provided that introduces a condition to accept the proposal; rather than contrasts the avoided alternative. Make a concrete concession, define the scope of the agreement, and propose a review. This is more precise than stating someone always makes noise or never cooperates.
